title: Editor E3: first Spotlight and Site baseline pictures (parked, needs a capture run)
detail: The Spotlight and Site surfaces are declared (LIVE-1157) but no picture exists. The first capture dispatch (run 133) was refused by the environment stamp: the committed set is stamped PREVIEW and the dispatch pointed at production. Nothing was photographed or committed. Re-dispatch e2e-manual with update_baselines on a preview base_url when the owner is next in Actions; it is not blocking E2 or the density work. The shell half will report PARTIAL without a member session, which is expected. FINDING 2026-10-20: /sites/<slug> only redirects to /spaces/<slug> (app/sites/[slug]/page.tsx), so the editor-site surface declared in LIVE-1157 photographs the Space's public page, not a Site. A real Site renders only on its own host (a <slug>.<apex> subdomain or custom domain, rewritten by proxy.ts to /hosted/<host>). Before capturing, point the editor-site surface at a path that renders the site, or give the suite a second base URL for the site host.

verify.note: Passes once an editor-spotlight baseline picture is committed.
